result.quote: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, struck the Philistine, and killed him.
result.reason: Verse 17 directly states how Abishai rescued David. Verse 16 identifies that Philistine as Ishbi-benob and says he intended to kill David. No materially different answer is supported. The edit makes the tense and subject clearer while preserving the original fact and answer scope.
